name: msit-git-lab
description: A bilingual desktop lab for learning Git and GitHub through real practice

scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.js && standard main.js preload.js forge.config.js lib/app-renderer.js lib/common-renderer.js lib/curriculum.js lib/git-service.js lib/labs.js lib/learning-path.js lib/home-renderer.js lib/own-repository-renderer.js lib/legacy-renderer.js lib/legacy-verification.js lib/locale.js lib/progress-store.js lib/build-challenges.js lib/build-pages.js menus/*.js scripts/*.js tests/*.js
scripts.build-all: npm run clean && npm run build-chals && npm run build-pages
scripts.make: node scripts/prepare-icons.js && electron-forge make && node scripts/make-dmg.js

author: MSIT (based on Git-it by Jessica Lord)
